content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Naperville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet education and hours-worked thresholds before investing in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions on your schedule, interact directly with certified practitioners, and build the project-management foundation required for exam eligibility and professional confidence.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including your education, work history, and course completion proof. Pay PMI's exam fee and wait for application approval before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce course material and practice test scenarios. Schedule your exam at an authorized Pearson VUE center and complete the computer-based assessment on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, renew your PMP every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional contributions. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing credential maintenance.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
